name: Raghav Chadha
role: Former Aam Aadmi Party Rajya Sabha MP from Punjab (2022-2026); Delhi Jal Board vice-chairman (2020-2022); BJP member since April 2026
summary: Chadha is a chartered accountant and former AAP politician whose recorded public statements focus on the tax burden on the middle class, Delhi's elected government's control over services, parliamentary freedom of speech, and farm price guarantees. He left AAP for the BJP in April 2026.

decide-locally.rationale: Delhi's powers against the Union are nearby; no stated position on deciding as locally as possible in general.

recall-officials.rationale: Raised the need for a right-to-recall law in Rajya Sabha Zero Hour on 11 February 2026 and proposed removal by voters before the end of a term, with safeguards (a 35-40% petition threshold, an 18-month lock-in, and a majority vote). He said five years is a long tenure.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Argued in the 2023 Delhi services debate that the central government had to follow a Supreme Court Constitution Bench ruling and that defying it was an insult to the court. He treated the court's ruling as binding on the executive, which is the opposite of the statement.

suppress-opposition.rationale: In July 2022 he called a government list of banned parliamentary words "uncalled for and aimed at gagging the voice of the Opposition" and said it was shocking that the government was trying to suppress the voice of the Opposition.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Opposed the 2023 Delhi services ordinance and bill, which reduced the powers of an elected regional government by Union legislation. He argued it would set a precedent for non-BJP states and weaken state autonomy, and that it changed the constitutional arrangement without amendment. The statement is about this specific instance and the report paraphrases part of his argument.

farm-price-support.rationale: Introduced the Minimum Support Price Guarantee Bill, 2022 in the Rajya Sabha on 5 August 2022, giving every farmer a legal right to a guaranteed MSP for crops. Introducing a bill is more than a vote, but the bill's full text was not opened, so the cooperative-credit and public-purchase parts of the statement are not confirmed.

close-ties-china.rationale: In a December 2022 Rajya Sabha intervention, as reported in an AAP press release, he said "It is high time to stop trade with China and give them an economic blow" and relayed Arvind Kejriwal's advice to stop all trade with China. The release is partisan, and the full transcript was not opened.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Criticised GST on everyday goods and services, saying a vaccine given to a newborn is taxed at 5 per cent and photography services at 18 per cent. The reported speech does not give a specific rate cut, so this is a medium-confidence reading.

notes: Coverage is thin for the statement list. Most of his Rajya Sabha speeches were reached only through press reports (Punjab Kesari, DT Next, Tribune, Siasat, an AAP press release), not parliamentary transcripts: the sansad.in and rsdebate.nic.in transcripts were not opened and his Budget speeches (2024, 2025) were not read in full. Several plausible matches were left null because the source did not state the position: tax-the-wealthy, universal-healthcare (his health-insurance and right-to-health-checkup remarks do not say how care should be funded), local-essentials-public (Delhi Jal Board record without a stated view on ownership), punish-blasphemy (he demanded strict punishment for sacrilege in Punjab, which is nearby but not blasphemy as such), defensive-wars-only (Operation Sindoor remarks), and gender-parity-bodies (women's reservation bill, source not opened). Private members' bills on defamation decriminalisation and the Representation of the People Amendment have no matching statement. Positions on EVMs, the Delhi model's free services, secularism, and civil liberties beyond the above were not found in any source opened.
